Director of Delivery Operations @ Curri | SpaceX Alum

Ventura, California, United States (US)

## About

I'm obsessed with the space between zero and scale. SpaceX taught me how to think: first principles, no assumptions, move fast, and never confuse activity with progress. I left to apply that in a different kind of mission: helping people live longer, healthier lives at NOVOS, where I was brought in to build the operations from scratch. What followed was four years of figuring things out in real time. Building a supply chain with no playbook. Launching products from concept to shelf. Fixing a CX team that wasn't working and deploying AI that made the humans better, not redundant. Writing code to build tools when the spreadsheets stopped being enough. It's messy, iterative work. And I find it genuinely fascinating. The thread across all of it isn't the outcomes. It's the craft. The process of taking something from an idea to something real, then making it repeatable, then making it scale. That transition is where I do my best work.
